input.quote: Upon any such termination, Contractor will be paid all fees and expenses that have been incurred or earned in connection with the performance of the Services through the effective date of such termination.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no liquidated damages, penalty, late-payment charge, minimum-commitment or early-termination fee payable by Clear Capital. Compensation (§ 3) is strictly time-and-materials plus actual out-of-pocket expenses, and both termination provisions (§ 6(b) and the mis-numbered § 7(c)) limit Company's post-termination payment obligation to fees and expenses actually incurred or earned through the effective date of termination — an accrued-amounts formulation, not a liquidated sum. Section 7 addresses only liability caps, consequential damages waiver and attorneys' fees; it imposes no stipulated damages on Company (and § 5 even relieves Company of any fee obligation on certain terminations). Nothing to flag; the preferred position (no Customer-payable liquidated damages or penalties) is already met, so no redline is proposed.
